## R-054 — Session 45, part 10d: the script, the signed release, the README and the manuals, and phase 10's acceptance

- Status: recorded
- Date: 2026-11-20
- Who: integrator Claude Code, `claude-opus-5-5`; Codex (`codex-cli 0.166.0`, `gpt-6.1-sol`, effort high, `codex exec
  -s workspace-write` in a scope of 3 GB, with no network), which wrote the READMEs and checked the manuals (from
  `target/review-10d-texts/`, reading only) and reviewed the part (from `target/review-10d/`, a disposable clone
  brought to each commit reviewed, with a copy of the registry).
- Start: HEAD `5d532cd`, tree clean.
- Read: `STATUS.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `plan.md` (row 10, "Phase 10"), `core-specification.md` (REQ-INS-1 to REQ-INS-8,
  "Installation, as phase 10's opening fixed it" points 1 to 11 with the amendments of parts 10a to 10c, sections 4,
  5, 7, 11.4, 12 and 13), `architecture-decisions.md` AD-7 and AD-9, `ALAMBIQUE.md` sections 1 and 2 and 6.17, 6.45,
  6.46, D-096, D-097, D-098, D-107, R-053; `xel/fermento.md` (no pending point); the skills `verify-part`,
  `codex-review`, `differential-review` and `sharp-edges`; the code of `tools/budget/`, `cli/decl.rs`, `cli/write.rs`,
  `cli/check.rs`, `cli/tasks.rs`, the adapters' markers, `crates/fabrewk/src/main.rs`, the tests' fixtures and
  `onboard.rs`, `surface.rs`; the generated reference. Fetched over the network: musl's `COPYRIGHT` at `v1.2.5`
  (git.musl-libc.org, SHA-256 `f9bc4423…55af`) and LLVM's `libunwind/LICENSE.TXT` at `llvmorg-23.1.1`
  (github.com/llvm/llvm-project, SHA-256 `b5efebca…7b6d`). The integrator was refused reading `~/.ssh/`; the maestro
  pasted the new key's public line in chat. No credential of the person's was read.
- Decided: D-108 (version, address, signer, notices), D-109 (outside contributions not accepted yet), D-110 (phase
  10 closed).
- Delivered (`e8f6e99` to `baceb4d`): the version 0.1.0; `install.sh` (POSIX `sh`, as "Amended in part 10d" in
  `core-specification.md` says) and `crates/fabrewk/tests/script.rs` (12 cases in `dash`, a local release signed by
  a fixture key, a fake `uname`, a pseudo-terminal for the offer); `budget notices` and `budget release` in
  `tools/budget` (`src/notices.rs`, `src/release.rs`, `notices/`, `tests/notices.rs`); `README.md` and
  `README.es-MX.md`, written by Codex; the manuals `docs/en/` and `docs/es-MX/` (installation and onboarding, working
  with Fabrewk, the commands), written by the integrator; the reference names no JSON documents for `onboard`; the
  catalogue's text for exit status 1, which said "nothing was written" also of a refusal after the events.
- The texts (6.45): Codex wrote both READMEs from points 10 and 11 and AD-7; the integrator checked them against the
  code and applied them as written. Codex checked the manuals: P10D-T1 to P10D-T12, each confirmed against the code
  and corrected in `51bb261` (the completions' directory, zsh's source step, the receipt unsigned, an existing
  `CLAUDE.md`'s block, `PLAN_CHANGED` as it is, the plan's views by name, `run <stage>`, `check`'s exit 3, exit 1,
  what `--help` prints, `--json` for built-in commands, the Spanish placeholder).
- The integrator's own review found, before or between Codex's passes: `onboard` offered from a subdirectory ran
  there, where it refuses (`3c4a639`); `budget notices` took Fedora's `rustc` 1.100.0, found by a dry run of the
  acceptance (`b07bc91`); a relative `HOME` or `TMPDIR` starting with `-` read as an option (`71b4623`).
- Codex's passes, each over the commit named, confirmed blocking findings (non-blocking in brackets):
  1. `51bb261`: 4. P10D-1: an output closed under the script (SIGPIPE) left the downloads. P10D-2: a signal right
     after the first `mktemp`, before the traps, left the directory. P10D-3: a repository whose name ends in a line
     end lost it, and `onboard` ran in a sibling. P10D-4: `budget release` packaged a GNU dynamic binary. Corrected
     in `4804cb3`.
  2. `4804cb3`: 1. P10D-5: GNU `tar` read escapes in a `TMPDIR` holding a backslash. Corrected in `2e949ca`.
  3. `2e949ca`: 1 [1]. P10D-6: a relative `TMPDIR` such as `tmp=path` made `awk` take a path for an assignment.
     P10D-7 (coverage): no case told `/dev/tty` from standard input. Corrected in `71b4623`.
  4. `71b4623`: accept, no finding; P10D-1 to P10D-7 closed; Codex listed every value the script hands a program and
     found none it can read as an option, an assignment, an escape or a pattern.
  The third pass did not lower the count; the fourth did, so no two retries passed without progress. Every finding
  was reproduced before its correction; each new test failed without it.
- Mutation over `5d532cd..HEAD`, in a 2 GB scope with `ulimit -v 1600000`: `budget` (`-j 2 --timeout 90`): 85
  mutants, 58 caught, 25 unviable, 2 missed (`set_mode` made `Ok(())`, unseen under the usual umask; `check_elf`'s
  `||` made `&&`, never met by an ELF of another architecture); killed in `baceb4d` (a release under umask 077 gives
  the same bytes; an x86-64 header is refused), `--iterate`: 2 caught. The core and the binary (`--test-workspace
  true --features fabrewk-core/fault-injection -j 1 --timeout 400`, the tests selected `--test surface`, the one
  reached by the change in `decl.rs`): 5 mutants, 3 caught, 2 unviable. None missed, none equivalent. The script is
  not Rust: seven written mutations of it (the signature check, the checksum, the platform, a marker, the rename, the
  options, the checksum's count) each failed its tests, and Codex checked P10D-7's.
- Verified (`verify-part`), clean clone of `baceb4d`, every step in a user scope of 2 GB with two build jobs: the
  first run of the suite failed once, `d_092_only_the_helper_written_still_running_with_its_start_time_and_program_is_ended`
  in `crates/confine-bwrap/tests/cell.rs:616` (part 9a's, unchanged), with `ETXTBSY` ("Text file busy") on spawning
  the program it had just copied, a race with another test thread's `fork`; the second run, `--no-fail-fast`: 741
  tests passed, 11 ignored. With `fault-injection`, the crash and fault suites, 52, green; the musl release build,
  `budget check` (the core 12,312 of 12,500; the installer 1,073 of 1,200; the backend 318 of 400; Claude Code's
  adapter 269 of 600; Codex's 319 of 600; 5 direct runtime crates; 31 in the release build; the binary 3,674,504
  bytes), both clippy runs, fmt and `cargo deny` clean; `--version --json` gives 0.1.0 with no feature. No idle
  `pasta` before or after.
- The release (D-108): made by `budget release` from the clean clone of `baceb4d` into `target/release-0.1.0/`:
  `fabrewk-0.1.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz` (1,711,510 bytes) and `SHA256SUMS`, which reads
  `0c13dfb1bb56e5812a750e9d45218ae283e984ccb9958b53e0c51ee47ffe19d3  fabrewk-0.1.0-linux-aarch64.tar.gz`; the archive is
  reproducible from `baceb4d` with the toolchain 1.99.1, so this signature stays valid for a remade one. The maestro
  signed `SHA256SUMS` in their terminal with `ssh-keygen -Y sign -n fabrewk-release -f ~/.ssh/fabrewk_xel_ed25519`;
  `ssh-keygen -Y verify` against the script's line: `Good "fabrewk-release" signature for xel with ED25519 key
  SHA256:aX24gH8qQN8AR5J7pJ+gcbhc6O/41G1D8fTikhp7XrM`. `SHA256SUMS.sig`:

      -----BEGIN SSH SIGNATURE-----
      U1NIU0lHAAAAAQAAADMAAAALc3NoLWVkMjU1MTkAAAAgyk1/DfJjixvsI7nFQIR9FC4+3D
      pSViJqXtj8xYIcVV8AAAAPZmFicmV3ay1yZWxlYXNlAAAAAAAAAAZzaGE1MTIAAABTAAAA
      C3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAQLhFFzOvPUQ1q4wCsPiDpkX1Mbz+8QR54bniP2z5nTf7NP0IrK
      L3KhBFDYpPUGmA/rs/EHT+dKGNAaJA1lWHPAs=
      -----END SSH SIGNATURE-----

- Phase 10's acceptance (plan row 10), in disposable repositories and a disposable home under
  `target/acceptance-10d/`, by a script of the integrator's (a Python program run with `-I`, outside the repository),
  with the signed release: 23 of 23 held. The release's signature by `xel` in `fabrewk-release`; `SHA256SUMS` lists
  the archive; the archive holds exactly the binary, the licences, the notices and the completions; both notices
  files equal a fresh `budget notices` from the clean clone. A copy of `install.sh` whose address alone points to the
  local release (`file://`), in `dash` under `setsid`: exit 0, exactly `~/.local/bin/fabrewk` installed, the
  archive's binary, the temporary directory empty, 0.1.0 with no feature. Verdict `adopt` through `onboard` on a
  pseudo-terminal in `es-MX`, `unpublished` with the warning shown: a no, and a yes with no words (the end of input),
  each left the repository and the home byte-identical; the yes and the words applied the plan: `assessed`,
  `publication-decided` (`unpublished`, `warningShown` true, the words as typed, `es-MX`), `policy-adopted`,
  `installed`; the verdict `adopt`; `check` passes; the product ignores `.brewstillery/`. Verdict `review` (`assess
  --mode review`): `apply` refuses `MODE_NOT_AVAILABLE`, nothing written. Verdict `none` (an `AGENTS.md` with an edit
  not committed): `apply` refuses `VERDICT_NONE`, nothing written. Its log: `target/acceptance-10d.log`.
- What section 13 assigns to phase 10, criterion by criterion (section 12's rows):
  - REQ-INS-1 and REQ-INS-2: `crates/fabrewk/tests/install.rs` (part 10a, R-050, R-051).
  - REQ-INS-3: `apply.rs`, `req_ins_3_apply_writes_the_plan_s_files_and_its_five_events_in_order` and the refusals'
    tests (part 10b, R-052); this session's acceptance.
  - REQ-INS-4: `onboard.rs` (part 10c, R-053); this session's acceptance in `es-MX`.
  - REQ-INS-5: not built; `MODE_NOT_AVAILABLE`'s test in `apply.rs`; this session's acceptance.
  - REQ-INS-6: `script.rs` in `dash` with a fixture key: exactly one file; a changed binary, checksum file or
    signature, another key or namespace installs nothing; no option, no `sudo`; the READMEs' prompt ends at `fabrewk
    assess` and never runs `apply`; this session's acceptance with the signed release.
  - REQ-INS-7: `script.rs`, `req_ins_7_an_unsupported_platform_is_refused_with_the_supported_list`.
  - REQ-INS-8: `apply.rs`, `install.rs`, `onboard.rs` (parts 10a to 10c).
  - REQ-DOM-1, REQ-DOM-6: `apply.rs` (part 10b) and the flows.
  - REQ-SEC-6: `crates/adapter-*/tests/launch.rs` (phase 9) and the flows from a real `apply` (part 10b).
  - REQ-BUD-5's release notices: `tools/budget/tests/notices.rs` (a release's notices equal a fresh generation, and
    deterministic); this session's acceptance with the signed release.
  - F-1 and F-2 from a real `apply`, the test helper's project events retired, the crash suite over `apply`:
    `flows.rs` and `crash.rs` (part 10b, R-052).
- Measured: the core 12,312 of 12,500 (+2 over the part; 188 lines left); the installer 1,073 of 1,200 (unchanged).
- Interpretations the maestro may want to read (each in the specification's "Amended in part 10d"):
  1. The third-party notices hold the toolchain's libraries too (D-108 point 4), and `budget notices` refuses a
     `rustc` other than 1.99.1: a release is made with the workspace's toolchain only.
  2. The script refuses a `HOME` or a `TMPDIR` that is not absolute.
  3. Inside an agent the script offers nothing and names `fabrewk assess`; it reads the same markers as the core.
  4. The README's preset prompt asks for an absolute path of the key, so that a quoted `~/` stays the agent's
     problem, not Fabrewk's (Codex's choice).
  5. The READMEs say the templates Fabrewk writes into served repositories are under MIT-0 (AD-9, decided in D-036).
  6. Section 5's `run <stage>` and phase 9's code differ (D-110's consequences).
- Phase 10 is closed (D-110). The review directories, the clean clone and the mutation's output are removed after
  this entry; `target/release-0.1.0/` is kept for the maestro's publication.
payload.title: Session 45, part 10d: the script, the signed release, the README and the manuals, and phase 10's acceptance
